notes.title: Play the demo of Free Agency in the Steam Game Festival!
notes.notes: Hello! A demo of [b]Free Agency[/b] is playable in the Steam Game Festival. Please share any feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1215020/discussions/]Steam Community[/url] or on our [url=https://www.discord.gg/thesheepsmeow]Discord[/url]. Enjoy!
